text.p: Duramed Pharmaceuticals Inc said on Friday it had completed its purchase of the assets and business of Hallmark Pharmaceuticals Inc.
Hallmark is a privately held pharmaceutical development company headquartered in Somerset, N.J.

The company said in a statement that it issued to Hallmark 640,000 shares of Duramed common stock and warrants to purchase 400,000 shares of Duramed common stock at a purchase price of $25 per share and will assume certain obligations of Hallmark.

As reporrted before , the consummation of the transaction will result in a non-cash charge estimated to be about $10.5 million for the recognition of purchased research and development. The charge will be included in the company's operating results for the third quarter ending Sept 30, 1996.
